correctness.rationale: For P=pq, candidates m+Pk with m mod P avoiding residues 0,1 at p and q have exactly (r−1)/2+1_{m odd} odd lifts for 0<=k<r. Deleting two distinct excluded residues modulo r yields 2T(Pr)−S(Pr)=|G_P|+2O_P−2B_r. When r>P, the CRT digit u given by ur ≡ m−c (mod P) ensures parity of removed lift remains fixed for r modulo 2P. Exact finite certificates are (|G|,O,B)=(63,30,68) for p5 q23 r349 and (75,38,70) for p7 q17 r269, giving −13,+11. Dirichlet supplies infinitely many primes in the coprime progressions. Finite counts are not used to establish prime infinitude.
